title: XGIMI Unveils 4K/120Hz Ultra-Short-Throw Projector Series
summary: XGIMI previewed its AURA 3 Series at IFA 2026, featuring the flagship Aura 3 Max and Aura 3 Pro as the world's first 4K/120Hz ultra-short-throw projectors.

title: Creality Debuts New 3D Printing and Digital Fabrication Portfolio
summary: Creality introduced new systems spanning filament recycling, resin printing, 3D scanning, laser processing, and digitally manufactured footwear.

title: Dolphin Adopts AI Simulation Tools for Cooling Systems
summary: Dolphin plans to implement CFD and thermal simulations across its heavy-duty and industrial product ranges for cooling system designs.

title: Pudu D7 Semi-Humanoid Robot Named IFA Innovation Honoree
summary: The Pudu D7 semi-humanoid robot features dual-arm manipulation and autonomous battery swapping to support industrial, warehouse, retail, and hospitality tasks.

title: Kawasaki and EdgeCortix Partner on AI Defense Systems
summary: Kawasaki and EdgeCortix launched a multi-year program covering technology development, system integration, and prototypes for AI defense systems.

title: 83% of British Cities Highly Vulnerable to Urban Heat
summary: Analysis from Ordnance Survey, the Met Office, and 4 Earth Intelligence reveals that 59 British cities are highly vulnerable to urban heat.

title: Startup Vaire Computing Builds Energy-Recycling Chips
summary: Startup Vaire Computing is developing reversible computing chips designed to recycle energy usually thrown away as heat.

title: Startup Innovates Cheaper and Cleaner Steel Production
summary: A new startup is working on making steel cleaner and cheaper by modernizing the traditional iron ore purification process.

title: SKF and Sentea Partner on Integrated Sensing Platform
summary: SKF has partnered with Sentea on the SKF Core platform to combine sensing, processing, and communication for machine intelligence.

title: ASML and TSMC Lead 12-inch Photomask Transition
summary: ASML and TSMC announced a collaborative initiative to transition the semiconductor industry to larger-format EUV lithography photomasks.

title: Brain Wave-Tracking Wearable Detects Focus Levels
summary: A new wearable device uses EEG technology to track brain waves and tell users how often their mind drifts.

title: Microcooling Enables Agentic AI
summary: Microcooling technologies are becoming a critical enabler for tiny devices to beat heat and sustain agentic AI intelligence.

title: Agility Robotics Reports Financials Ahead of SPAC
summary: Agility Robotics revealed $1.8 million in revenue and a $140 million operating loss in an S-4 filing as it plans to scale its Digit humanoid robot business.

title: Phytec Showcases phyVIP Platform for Embedded AI Vision
summary: Phytec is showcasing its phyVIP platform at the Vision trade fair to speed up embedded AI-based vision development.

title: Winvic Appointed for Witton-le-Wear Bridge Scheme
summary: Durham County Council appointed Winvic Construction to design the Witton Le Wear Bridge scheme on the A68.

title: Kioxia Introduces Flash-for-DRAM Initiative for AI
summary: Kioxia unveiled a CXL-attached memory expansion using NAND flash optimized for high-speed processing alongside AI compute devices.

title: Solid-State Cooling Device Uses Heat to Generate Cold
summary: Scientists built a solid-state cooling device that uses heat to generate cold to recycle waste heat in electronics.

title: Pressure Sensors Improve Robotic Gripping Accuracy
summary: Pressure sensors can help improve robotic bin picking from first contact through surface deformation and stable holds.
